t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Werte Yooz distike amchuaweke pachamke paj zapa, amkin Mayziz zapa, anzchiruke kitiniki. Nekbe, vitteíkwichanchyo Koolikkua, amke thapa chullakkichiimcha, mazek yakha Yooz zallizzie, yanapt'icha anawaliinakista, amaztera personiikistra.
